win_claim.quote: Smote + Tomek and Smote + ENN (two of the methods proposed in this work) in particular for data sets with few positive (minority) examples, provided very good results in practice.

n_classes=2 is the binarized task stated on p.3 ('we consider two-class problems'); original class counts of multiclass sources not printed

notes: Proposed methods: Smote+ENN, Smote+Tomek (and CNN+Tomek under-sampler). Part B uses Smote+ENN; Smote+Tomek pruned values are in best_other where it is best. Smote+Tomek pruned AUC (Table 4): Pima 84.46(5.84), German 81.75(4.78), Post-operative 41.80(16.59), Haberman 75.73(6.55), Splice-ie 98.26(0.51), Splice-ei 98.87(0.44), Vehicle 98.96(0.98), Letter-vowel 98.90(0.20), New-thyroid 98.91(1.84), E.Coli 95.98(4.21), Satimage 95.43(1.03), Flag 79.30(28.68), Glass 91.40(8.24), Letter-a 99.91(0.12), Nursery 99.27(0.36). Unpruned (Pruning=no) Smote+ENN / Smote / Smote+Tomek: Pima 83.64(5.35)/85.97(5.82)/85.56(6.02); German 83.90(3.70))/84.51(4.55)/84.02(3.94); Post-operative 59.48(34.91)/68.19(26.62)/47.99(16.61); Haberman 77.01(5.10)/75.45(11.02)/78.41(7.11); Splice-ie 98.88(0.34)/99.19(0.28)/99.13(0.31); Splice-ei 99.49(0.16)/99.52(0.26)/99.51(0.32); Vehicle 98.22(0.90)/99.04(0.85)/99.04(0.85); Letter-vowel 99.19(0.15)/99.15(0.17)/99.14(0.17); New-thyroid 99.22(1.72)/98.91(1.84)/98.91(1.84); E.Coli 95.29(3.79)/95.49(4.30)/95.98(4.21); Satimage 96.06(1.20)/95.69(1.28)/95.69(1.28); Flag 78.56(28.79)/73.87(30.34)/82.06(29.52); Glass 93.40(7.61)/91.27(8.38)/91.27(8.38); Letter-a 99.91(0.14)/99.92(0.12)/99.92(0.12); Nursery 99.20(0.51)/99.75(0.34)/99.53(0.31). All methods balance to 50/50; k-NN steps use HVDM distance; ENN uses 3 nearest neighbours and removes examples of both classes. No G-mean or F-measure reported; AUC is the only per-dataset metric. Tables 8-9 give tree complexity (rules, conditions per rule) for unpruned trees. Text extraction of Tables 4/5 was interleaved, values read from rendered pages 7-8.
